guidelineReviewEvidence: Official primary Apple HIG Markdown inspected individually 2026-11-19: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion.md. Apple's Motion article advises purposeful, brief, cancellable feedback and making animation optional; motion cannot be the sole signal and should respect comfort/preferences. It warns against gratuitous frequent-interface animations, with additional peripheral/large-object guidance specific to visionOS.

NovaPharm web assessment: Use browser reduced-motion media queries and runtime preference changes to reduce transitions, avoid animated-only status for medicine data, retain visible text for validation, and verify cancellation/keyboard interaction across actual corporate and protected pages.

Native scope: iOS — Use iOS native motion settings and Reduce Motion awareness, short state-following transitions and accessibility alternatives; real device and VoiceOver tests are necessary before release.; Android — Use Android system animator scale/Reduce Motion equivalents, support TalkBack and motion-free state feedback in native screens, and do not import Apple SF Symbol animation assets..
